verses.1: Happy those who do not follow the counsel of the wicked, Nor go the way of sinners, nor sit in company with scoffers.
verses.2: Rather, the law of the LORD is their joy; God's law they study day and night.
verses.3: They are like a tree planted near streams of water, that yields its fruit in season; Its leaves never wither; whatever they do prospers.
verses.4: But not the wicked! They are like chaff driven by the wind.
verses.5: Therefore the wicked will not survive judgment, nor will sinners in the assembly of the just.
verses.6: The LORD watches over the way of the just, but the way of the wicked leads to ruin.

notes.text: Those: literally, "the man." That word is used here and in many of the Psalms as typical, and therefore is translated "they." The way: a common biblical term for manner of living or moral conduct (Psalm 32:8; 101:2, 6; Proverb 2:20; 1 Kings 8:36).
The law of the LORD: either the Torah, the first five books of the Bible, or, more probably, divine teaching or instruction.
The wicked: those who by their actions distance themselves from God's life-giving presence.
